name: trial-run
description: Puts risky shell commands on trial: a prosecutor, a defense and a judge argue in a pane. A guilty verdict stops the command; an acquittal leaves it to your own permission rules.

strictness.title: Strictness
strictness.description: How readily the judge convicts: lenient, fair or hanging. It changes the judge's doctrine only: a conviction still denies and an acquittal still hands the decision to your permission rules.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Bang the gavel and read the verdict out loud.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: The charges that go to trial, by id: recursive-delete, force-push, hard-reset, git-clean, drop-table, kubectl-delete, terraform-destroy, unread-script. A command charged with none of them is left to your permission rules.
